transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before I publish the December holiday on-call roster, I need to run the holiday-readiness readback. I need SRE, payments engineering, customer support, and security to each confirm your coverage for December 24, 25, and 26, and flag any exceptions. The draft has Riley as primary and Casey as secondary for all three days, with a 30-minute escalation target. Please go through your teams' coverage and let me know what you find.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception: my approved leave covers December 25, so I cannot be primary or secondary on-call that day. The roster spreadsheet hasn't been updated yet, but the leave is confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception from payments engineering. The payments service's enterprise response agreement requires a named payments engineer to acknowledge a production alert within exactly 10 minutes on all three dates — December 24, 25, and 26 — rather than the draft's 30-minute escalation target. I confirmed this clause with account operations this morning but haven't updated the on-call ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception from customer support. The customer Meridian has a contractual requirement for a support liaison to contact its administrators during any December 26 production incident, so I must be named as the December 26 customer liaison. I found this in an account-notes review yesterday, but the holiday handoff document still has the default unassigned value.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception from security. A certificate rotation for the production identity service is scheduled for December 26 from 21:00 to 23:00 and requires me, Jordan, as the security escalation contact and the sole secondary on-call for December 26. I confirmed the timing during a certificate inventory, but the change ticket has not yet been linked to the holiday roster.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Update the roster spreadsheet to reflect Riley's approved leave on December 25 and removal from primary on that date.
Update the on-call ticket to reflect the 10-minute payment alert acknowledgment requirement for all three dates.
Update the holiday handoff document to name Taylor as the December 26 customer liaison for Meridian.
Link the certificate rotation change ticket to the holiday roster and record Jordan as sole secondary on-call for December 26.
